title: Zesty Dense Jamaican Sun Dried Tomato Roast
description: A briny and dense Jamaican dish featuring sun-dried tomatoes and roast, perfect for a vegan-friendly dinner option.

ingredients.name: sun dried tomatoes
ingredients.notes: packed in oil, drained and chopped

ingredients.name: portobello mushrooms
ingredients.notes: stems removed and caps sliced 1/2 inch thick

instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a blender or food processor, combine sun dried tomatoes, red onion, scotch bonnet peppers, allspice, and thyme, and blend until coarsely chopped.
In a large bowl, whisk together the blended tomato mixture, nutritional yeast, and vegetable broth.
Add the sliced portobello mushrooms to the bowl and toss to coat with the tomato mixture.
Transfer the mushroom mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish and cover with aluminum foil.
Roast the mushrooms in the preheated oven for 30 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue roasting for an additional 20 minutes, or until the mushrooms are tender and the top is lightly browned.
Remove the dish from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
Serve the Zesty Dense Jamaican Sun Dried Tomato Roast hot, garnished with fresh thyme if desired.
